description: This Perl module defines the package Git::LoadCPAN, which provides a wrapper for loading modules from CPAN or Git's own copy, facilitating optional fallback mechanisms. It manages module loading logic, handles dependencies, and contains constants for configuration, along with an import method that dynamically requires modules and manages fallback logic.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Handles the module import process, attempting to require the specified module from Perl's package path, and falling back to an alternative directory if the module is not found, based on configuration constants.
